rationale: diffusion_recon_dcstep_constrained_mayo_v4-claude-agentic: recon_ckpt=/cluster/maier/Agent4CT/checkpoints/ddpm_mayo_constrained_v4.pt, recon_mode=dps, recon_sample_steps=80, recon_eta=1.0, recon_init=fbp, recon_eta_clamp=False, recon_dcstep_every=5, recon_dcstep_n_cg=3, recon_dcstep_warmup=5, recon_dcstep_relax=1.0, recon_dc_solver=cg, val_n=70, train_n=0, rationale=iter-9 search-20260619-01 CONSTRAINED diff-recon — UNTRIED AXIS at the iter-8 best: recon_eta 30.0->1.0 (DPS/guidance gain). ONE KNOB: recon_eta only; val_n held at 70 (>=~60 representative), recon_sample_steps held at iter-8 T=80, recon_dc_solver=cg held (landed A-fix), relax=1.0/every5/n_cg3/warmup5 held. BASE = iter-8 BEST (recon_dc_solver=cg, T=80, eta=30, relax=1.0, every5/n_cg3/warmup5, val_n=70, SSIM 0.8533/hr0 — run-best). TRAJECTORY (val=L277, 321px geometry FOV, LD-FBP floor ~0.81): iter-1 T=25 legacy eta=30 SSIM 0.3937/hr0; iter-2 eta30->1 ON THE LEGACY DC PATH (T=25) 0.2366 (regressed); iter-3 relax1.0->0.3 0.2377 (flat); iter-4 T25->28 0.4784; iter-5 T28->40 (val214->120) 0.6647; iter-6 DC legacy->cg A-fix 0.7873; iter-7 T40->60 (val120->90) 0.8396; iter-8 T60->80 (val90->70) 0.8533 (BEST). KEY SIGNAL: the NFE lever is DECELERATING (NFE deltas +0.085 / +0.186 / +0.052 / +0.0138 for steps 25->28->40->60->80) AND has hit its budget floor — a further NFE rung (T=100) would force val_n<60 (no longer representative), so NFE is EXHAUSTED at the val_n floor. eta was ONLY EVER tested at iter-2 under the BROKEN legacy DC path on a coarse T=25 schedule, where it regressed; it has NEVER been retested on the corrected CG-DC path at high-NFE. eta is the LAST UNTRIED AXIS at the iter-8 best. FAILURE-MODE FRAMING (numbers): the recon sits SSIM 0.8533 just past the ~0.81 FBP floor; with the deterministic CG-DC re-embed now correct (iter-6 A-fix), eta=30 may be over-driving the per-step DPS correction relative to the now-anchoring CG-DC term. eta=1.0 is the literature/demo/breast DPS default (Chung 2023 adaptive-norm gain). HYPOTHESIS: at the iter-8 best (T=80, CG-DC), dropping the DPS gain eta 30->1 lets the corrected CG-DC term anchor the iterate while the score model refines structure -> SSIM moves vs 0.8533 (untried interaction; eta x corrected-DC was never measured). NUMERIC FALSIFIER: if SSIM <= 0.8533 (flat/below iter-8) at eta=1.0, the eta axis is EXHAUSTED on the corrected path too -> the {eta, relax, NFE} lever set is FULLY EXPLORED and the constrained-v4 result is FAITHFUL-BUT-REGIME-BOUNDED (LD-FBP near-complete at 2304 views; payoff awaits the 128-view SPARSE benchmarks + planned EMA v5 prior); constrained best stays iter-8 (SSIM 0.8533, hr 0). hr expected ~0 regardless (regime-bounded on dense Mayo). PREDICTED iter-9: SSIM ~0.83-0.86, hr 0. BUDGET: eta is a FREE scalar (no per-slice cost change vs iter-8). Per-slice-per-step from the CG path = 0.1957 s (iter-8 1095.8s/80/70). T=80 x val_n=70 x 0.1957 = 1096 s = 18.3 min < the HARD 1200s/20-min wall (1800s in-solver backstop + 30-min --time further backstops). val_n=70 held (>=~60, representative), no NFE change so no budget pressure. val=70 evenly-spaced L277, 321px detector-geometry FOV default (no fov=False). staged_canonical data, v3 mayo_ldct_fitted geometry, per-sample-ps single-val-ps probe, bg_target=truth, reuse ddpm_mayo_constrained_v4.pt (NO retrain), recon_dc_solver=cg (landed A-fix), 321px FOV.
